usageNotes: Use this to enumerate all PBS remote instances registered in Proxmox Datacenter Manager before performing remote-specific operations such as syncing or inspecting datastores. No parameters are required — the endpoint returns every configured remote. If the list is empty, no PBS remotes have been added to PDM yet and remote-scoped operations will fail.
tips: Each item in the response contains only the 'remote' ID field; use the ID to target subsequent remote-specific endpoints.
Remote IDs follow the pattern /^(?:[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._\-]*)$/ and are 2–32 characters — useful for validating user-supplied remote names before calling downstream operations.
Tokens are accepted (allowtoken: true), so API token auth is sufficient and no interactive session is needed.
